entries.title: Job 6:1
segments: Then Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 6:2
segments: Oh that my vexation were but weighed, And all my calamity laid in the balances!

entries.title: Job 6:3
segments: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas: Therefore have my words been rash.

entries.title: Job 6:4
segments: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, The poison whereof my spirit drinketh up: The terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.

entries.title: Job 6:5
segments: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? Or loweth the ox over his fodder?

entries.title: Job 6:6
segments: Can that which hath no savor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

entries.title: Job 6:7
segments: My soul refuseth to touch [them]; They are as loathsome food to me.

entries.title: Job 6:8
segments: Oh that I might have my request; And that God would grant [me] the thing that I long for!

entries.title: Job 6:9
segments: Even that it would please God to crush me; That he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

entries.title: Job 6:10
segments: And be it still my consolation, Yea, let me exult in pain that spareth not, That I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

entries.title: Job 6:11
segments: What is my strength, that I should wait? And what is mine end, that I should be patient?

entries.title: Job 6:12
segments: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of brass?

entries.title: Job 6:13
segments: Is it not that I have no help in me, And that wisdom is driven quite from me?

entries.title: Job 6:14
segments: To him that is ready to faint kindness [should be showed] from his friend; Even to him that forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.

entries.title: Job 6:15
segments: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, As the channel of brooks that pass away;

entries.title: Job 6:16
segments: Which are black by reason of the ice, [And] wherein the snow hideth itself:

entries.title: Job 6:17
segments: What time they wax warm, they vanish; When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

entries.title: Job 6:18
segments: The caravans [that travel] by the way of them turn aside; They go up into the waste, and perish.

entries.title: Job 6:19
segments: The caravans of Tema looked, The companies of Sheba waited for them.

entries.title: Job 6:20
segments: They were put to shame because they had hoped; They came thither, and were confounded.

entries.title: Job 6:21
segments: For now ye are nothing; Ye see a terror, and are afraid.

entries.title: Job 6:22
segments: Did I say, Give unto me? Or, Offer a present for me of your substance?

entries.title: Job 6:23
segments: Or, Deliver me from the adversary's hand? Or, Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors?

entries.title: Job 6:24
segments: Teach me, and I will hold my peace; And cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

entries.title: Job 6:25
segments: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what doth it reprove?

entries.title: Job 6:26
segments: Do ye think to reprove words, Seeing that the speeches of one that is desperate are as wind?

entries.title: Job 6:27
segments: Yea, ye would cast [lots] upon the fatherless, And make merchandise of your friend.

entries.title: Job 6:28
segments: Now therefore be pleased to look upon me; For surely I shall not lie to your face.

entries.title: Job 6:29
segments: Return, I pray you, let there be no injustice; Yea, return again, my cause is righteous.

entries.title: Job 6:30
segments: Is there injustice on my tongue? Cannot my taste discern mischievous things?
